snippet.title: Anant Singh की बेटी की शादी| 50 लाख रसगुल्ले और बिहार की गरीबी का तमाशा! #anantsingh  #biharpolitics
snippet.description:
50 लाख रसगुल्ले? 150 से ज्यादा व्यंजन, लाखों मेहमान, घुड़दौड़, हेलीपैड और एक ऐसी शाही दावत जिसकी चर्चा पूरे देश में हो रही है। लेकिन इस दावत से सबसे ताकतवर आदमी की शान बढ़ी और सबसे आसानी से किसका मजाक बना?

25 नवंबर 2026 को बिहार के मोकामा से विधायक अनंत सिंह की बेटी की शादी पटना जिले के नदवा गांव में हुई। सोशल मीडिया और मुख्यधारा के मीडिया में इस शादी की भव्यता की खूब चर्चा हुई। लेकिन क्या इस पूरी कवरेज में बिहार की गरीबी, सामंती राजनीति, जातिगत वर्चस्व, राजनीति के अपराधीकरण और आम आदमी की गरिमा से जुड़े जरूरी सवाल कहीं पीछे छूट गए?

अनंत सिंह और उनकी पत्नी की कुल घोषित संपत्ति 2025 के चुनावी हलफनामे के मुताबिक लगभग 100 करोड़ 62 लाख रुपये थी। इसी हलफनामे में अनंत सिंह ने अपने खिलाफ 28 लंबित आपराधिक मामले भी घोषित किए थे। इनमें हत्या, हत्या की कोशिश और वसूली जैसे गंभीर आरोपों से संबंधित मामले शामिल थे। इन आरोपों पर अंतिम फैसला अदालत का विषय है।

दुलारचंद यादव हत्या मामले में सुप्रीम कोर्ट द्वारा जमानत रद्द किए जाने और आत्मसमर्पण की समयसीमा का इस शादी की तारीख से क्या संबंध था? मीडिया ने शादी का मेन्यू तो याद रखा, लेकिन क्या जनता को विधायक का सार्वजनिक रिकॉर्ड भी उतनी ही प्रमुखता से बताया?

शीतल पी. सिंह इस विशेष एक्सप्लेनर में अनंत सिंह की बेटी की शादी के बहाने बिहार की सामाजिक, आर्थिक और राजनीतिक संरचना की गहरी पड़ताल करते हैं।

इस वीडियो में चर्चा है:

▪️ अनंत सिंह की बेटी की शादी और 50 लाख रसगुल्लों के वायरल दावे की वास्तविकता।
▪️ अनंत सिंह की घोषित संपत्ति और लंबित आपराधिक मामले।
▪️ दुलारचंद यादव हत्या मामला और सुप्रीम कोर्ट का आदेश।
▪️ मीडिया किस तरह 'बाहुबली' और 'छोटे सरकार' जैसे शब्दों से राजनीतिक रसूख को महिमामंडित करता है?
▪️ बिहार की राजनीति में जाति, जमीन और सामंती ताकत का ऐतिहासिक संबंध।
▪️ गंभीर आपराधिक मामलों वाले उम्मीदवारों को राजनीतिक दल टिकट क्यों देते हैं?
▪️ शादी में खाना खाने आए साधारण लोगों का सोशल मीडिया पर मजाक क्यों बनाया गया?
▪️ बिहार की गरीबी, आर्थिक असमानता और रोजगार की वास्तविक स्थिति।
▪️ लोकतंत्र में जनता की हैसियत मेहमान की है या नागरिक की?

**किसी विधायक की दावत में आपको भोजन मिल जाना अच्छी बात है। लेकिन क्या उसके दरवाजे पर आपकी शिकायत सुनने के लिए भी उतनी ही जगह है?**

वीडियो पूरा देखिए और कमेंट में बताइए कि ऐसी शादियों की मीडिया कवरेज आपको पत्रकारिता लगती है या राजनीतिक रसूख का महिमामंडन?

snippet.title: Truk Mini Pak Sidik Bermesin Motor, Bisa Angkut 2 Ton dan Berubah Jadi Molen!#rakitan #trukoleng
snippet.description:
Modal mesin motor, Pak Sidik bikin truk multifungsi!
Siapa sangka, mesin sepeda motor 150 cc bisa disulap menjadi truk mini yang mampu mengangkut muatan hingga hampir 2 ton Inilah truk Cupang buatan Pak Sidik, seorang perakit otodidak yang karyanya dibagikan oleh kreator Mister mobal. Truk ini menggunakan mesin merek Garuda. Menurut Pak Sidik, mesin tersebut sudah diracik dengan kompresi 12:1 untuk menunjang kebutuhan tenaga angkut. Bukan sekadar memasang mesin motor ke rangka, Pak Sidik juga membuat sendiri berbagai konstruksinya. Mulai dari rangka, as roda, dudukan roda, hingga engine mounting atau dudukan mesin bagian depan dan belakang. Untuk kaki-kakinya, truk ini menggunakan sokbreker Honda Supra yang dipadukan dengan pegas. Bagian roda menggunakan laher ukuran 6205, sedangkan dudukan mesinnya dilengkapi bantalan karet untuk membantu meredam getaran. Sistem transmisi juga disesuaikan agar bisa dioperasikan seperti kendaraan roda empat, dengan persneling maju, mundur, gigi satu hingga empat. Sementara kelistrikannya menggunakan kiprok Honda Tiger sistem full-wave untuk mendukung pengisian aki dan berbagai lampu kendaraan. Yang lebih menarik, truk Cupang ini memiliki bak multifungsi. Saat dibutuhkan untuk pekerjaan pengecoran, bagian belakangnya bisa dipasangi perangkat molen atau pengaduk semen. Setelah pekerjaan selesai, molen diturunkan dan diganti kembali dengan bak angkut biasa. Jadi, satu kendaraan bisa digunakan untuk dua pekerjaan berbeda. Pak Sidik juga memperlihatkan kemampuan truk ini mengangkut muatan lebih dari satu ton, bahkan mengklaim pernah membawa hampir dua ton. Inilah kreativitas Pak Sidik. Bermodalkan keterampilan otodidak, ia berhasil merancang truk mini dengan mesin sepeda motor dan konstruksi buatan sendiri. Kecil bentuknya, tetapi luar biasa kreativitas pembuatnya!

snippet.title: "'오빠 독약 로비' 자료" 어디서 나왔나..'한동훈 고리'로 압수수색 단행 (자막뉴스) / SBS
snippet.description:
무소속 한동훈 의원이 김승원 법무부 장관 후보자 관련 검찰 수사자료를 유출했다는 의혹을 수사 중인 경찰이 법무부와 공소청에 대한 강제수사에 착수했습니다.

서울경찰청 광역수사단 광역범죄수사대는 오늘(27일) 오전 9시부터 한 의원에 대한 공무상 비밀 누설 혐의 고발 사건과 관련해 법무부와 공소청, 서울서부지방공소청에서 압수수색 영장을 집행했습니다.

특히 공소청에선 정보통신계와 감찰계에서 필요한 자료를 확보하고 있습니다.

경찰은 수사 관례에 따라 압수수색 형식을 취했지만 수사에 필요한 자료를 임의로 제출받고 있는 것으로 알려졌습니다.

다만, 오늘 압수수색 대상엔 한동훈 의원은 포함되지 않았습니다.

해당 논란은 지난 9월 한동훈 의원이 당시 김승원 법무장관 후보자 검증 국면에서 김 후보자의 코로나19 치료제 임상시험 승인 청탁 의혹과 관련해 '서부지검 김승원 기소 계획 문서' 등을 공개하면서부터 시작됐습니다.

민주당은 이를 '수사자료 유출 게이트'로 규정하고 한동훈 의원을 공무상 비밀누설 등 혐의로 경찰에 고발했습니다.

경찰의 압수수색 소식에 한동훈 의원은 오늘 "경찰이 민중의 지팡이가 아니라 민주당의 지팡이가 되겠다고 나섰다"고 SNS에 썼습니다.

한 의원은 이어 "'오빠독약로비' 공익제보자 색출, 경찰 동원해서 마음대로 해 보라"면서 "저는 다시 돌아가도 국민만 보고 똑같이 할 것"이라고 목소리를 높였습니다.

snippet.title: How Did the Victim Reveal the Killer’s Name Across Two Cities?
snippet.description:
#animation #cartoon #anime #funnyvideo #fyp #foryou #tiktok #usa #motivation
A body was found lying across the border between two cities, leaving the police departments arguing over who had jurisdiction. Before dying, the victim desperately moved his body and turned his watch inward to leave behind a dying message. Conan realized that the body’s position formed the characters for “mouth,” “sun,” and “cross,” which, combined with the city border, pointed to Nakata. She claimed the surveillance footage proved she was standing by the window, but Conan exposed her trick of using props to create a fake silhouette. He also discovered that the murder weapon, a weighted sandbag, had been hidden inside her hair bun. Nakata eventually confessed. It turned out that the group had once delayed a rescue just to get more views, causing a mother to fall off a cliff and die. Years later, the girl they rescued was pushed down a flight of stairs by the victim. Seeking revenge for the girl, Nakata killed him with the very sandbag the girl had given her.

snippet.title: He Stopped His Widowed Sister From Touching the Cradle… Then Learned the Truth 😭 | Aari | #shorts
snippet.description:
He Stopped His Widowed Sister From Touching the Cradle… Then Learned the Truth 😭💔

It was a special day in Kishore's home.

His newborn son's naming ceremony was about to begin.

According to their family custom, the baby's paternal aunt would place him in the cradle and whisper his name into his ear.

Kishore's elder sister, Sharada, happily reached for the cradle.

But a relative whispered:

**“She's a widow. Her touch might bring bad luck to the baby.”**

In front of everyone, Kishore pulled the cradle rope away from his sister.

**“Sister, stay away. Don't touch the cradle.”** 💔

Sharada quietly stepped back toward the doorway.

Hidden inside the knot of her saree were a pair of tiny silver anklets.

She had spent three months stitching blouses to buy them for her nephew.

Holding the anklets close to her heart, she softly sang an old lullaby.

But nobody knew the story behind that song.

Thirty-four years earlier, Kishore's mother had died on the very night he was born.

Sharada was only twelve years old.

She left school after seventh grade to help raise her baby brother.

Years later, her husband died in an accident, just four years after their marriage.

Since then, she had lived in Kishore's home, earning a little money by stitching clothes.

Back at the naming ceremony, Kishore's wife, Sujatha, placed the baby in the cradle.

Another relative began rocking it.

But the baby wouldn't stop crying.

Just then, an elderly midwife named Parvathamma entered the house.

She looked at the cradle.

Then she looked at Sharada standing near the doorway.

**“Kishore, do you know who truly deserves to place this baby in the cradle?”** 😱

Everyone fell silent.

Parvathamma revealed what had happened thirty-four years earlier.

She had delivered Kishore in that very house.

His mother had passed away that night.

It was the rainy season, and there was no cradle for the newborn.

Twelve-year-old Sharada held her baby brother against her chest throughout the night.

She wrapped him in her own shawl to keep him warm.

**While he slept safely in her arms, she shivered in the cold.** 😭

The next morning, she put away her schoolbooks.

From that day, she devoted herself to raising him.

Then Parvathamma said:

**“Kishore, the first cradle you ever slept in was your sister's arms.”** 💔

Kishore looked toward the doorway.

Sharada was still holding the little silver anklets.

With tears in his eyes, he lifted his crying son from the cradle and placed him in his sister's arms.

The baby stopped crying.

Kishore sat at her feet.

**“Sister, forgive me. You were the one who held me when I was born. You should be the one to name my son.”** ❤️

Sharada gently placed the silver anklets on the baby's feet.

Then she laid him in the cradle, whispered his name into his ear, and began singing.

It was the same lullaby she had sung to Kishore thirty-four years earlier. 😭❤️

Why had Sharada never told her brother about her sacrifices?

Because she didn't want him to feel indebted to her.

**A sister's love is not a debt that needs to be repaid.**

**Moral of the Story:** Widowhood does not make anyone unlucky or unworthy of respect. A person's goodness comes from their heart, not their marital status.
